oimr.settings.title: One Inventory, Many Regrets
oimr.settings.section.slots: Waihona Mea & Lako i Hoʻolōkahi ʻia
oimr.settings.slots_duplication_warning: Aʻo: ʻO ka hoʻopio ʻana i ka hoʻolōkahi wahi e pāpālua ai nā mea (ʻano hana i manaʻo ʻia).
Inā waiho ʻia kekahi wahi paʻa lima a lako paha me ka hoʻolōkahi ʻole ʻia, mālama kaʻawale ʻia nā mea o kēlā me kēia mea pāʻani a hiki ke pāpālua i nā mea ke komo nā mea pāʻani, hoʻololi hui, a neʻe paha i nā mea. He hana i hoʻolālā ʻia a manaʻo ʻia kēia.
oimr.warning.affinity_reset: [OIMR] Loaʻa he helu pili kūpono ʻole ma ka hoʻonohonoho (> 100%% a kūpono ʻole paha); ua hoʻihoʻi ʻia ka pili i 100%%.
oimr.settings.affinity.tooltip: Hoʻomalu i ka ikaika o ka māhele ʻana i nā hopena, ke ola hou, ke kīkoʻo hope, ka ʻeha, a me ka Respiration. Ma 100%%, pili pū nā make a pau o nā hoa hui; ma lalo o 100%% e wehe ai ka pili o nā make koi (e laʻa ma 50%%, ʻo 10 ʻeha iā A e hāʻawi i 5 i nā hoa hui). ʻAʻole pili i nā wahi waihona i hoʻolōkahi ʻia.
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator: ʻEha no 1 puʻuwai hui: %s (%s mau puʻuwai)

oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.t: Hōʻike i ka nui o ka ʻeha e loaʻa ai i hoʻokahi lālā (2 HP = 1 puʻuwai) i mea e loaʻa ai i nā hoa hui 1 puʻuwai piha (2 HP) o ka ʻeha i māhele ʻia.
oimr.settings.hunger_weight.tooltip: Mea hoʻonui pau pōloli no kēlā me kēia mea pāʻani: (Weight * Action) / PartySize.
oimr.settings.xp_weight.tooltip: Mea hoʻonui loaʻa ʻike XP no kēlā me kēia mea pāʻani: (Weight * XP) / PartySize. ʻAʻole loli ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka XP (hoʻokalakupua, kua hao).
oimr.settings.sync_hotbar.tooltip: Ke ʻā ʻia, māhele pū ʻia nā wahi pahu lima ʻeiwa a pau (me kou lima nui) ma waena o ka hui.

oimr.settings.underwater_muffle.tooltip: Hoʻopili i ke kānana leo mumulu lalo wai i nā manawa e noho ai ʻoe a kekahi hoa hui i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma lalo o ka wai.
